description: This file contains class and function definitions for monitoring events, statistical aggregation, and synchronization constructs used within PyTorch's C++ source code, including event logging, aggregation, and wait counter management.

classes.name: Aggregation
classes.description: Enumeration of different aggregation types for statistical analysis.

classes.name: Stat
classes.description: Class for maintaining statistics with specified aggregation methods over a window size.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents an event with a name, timestamp, and associated data.

classes.name: EventHandlerHandle
classes.description: Handles registration of event callback functions.

classes.name: _WaitCounterTracker
classes.description: Context manager for wait counter tracking, managing enter and exit hooks.

classes.name: _WaitCounter
classes.description: Class representing a wait counter for synchronization, identified by a key.

methods.name: log_event
methods.description: Logs an event with its details.

methods.name: register_event_handler
methods.description: Registers a callback function to handle events.

methods.name: unregister_event_handler
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered event handler using its handle.
